data.title: 丛雨 · 玻璃房里浇错的一盆苗
data.description: 花圃玻璃房里，丛雨刚往写着「薄荷」的木牌旁浇了半壶水，就发现木牌插反了。她一手提住浇水壶，一手把牌子调个方向。白棉裙上的浅绿花布和草帽上的红带子都被午后的光照亮。
data.action: 提住浇水壶，把花盆里插反的木牌转正
data.lighting: 玻璃顶透下的散射日光照着花苗和裙摆
data.camera: 站姿侧前全身，保留一整排花盆
data.promptProse: In the old glasshouse, Murasame catches a plant label facing the wrong way and turns it around with one hand, a watering can hanging from the other. Mint-green floral panels break up her white cotton sundress. The red ribbon on her straw hat catches a patch of afternoon light from the glass roof.
data.animaCaption: She keeps the can level while flipping the little marker at the edge of the flower pot.
